name: Cannabis
tierNotes: Threshold: nothing you could swear to (this profile is the realism floor).
Light: warmth + faint halos around lights.
Common: time hiccups (spike-curve stutter, held frames every 4–9 s) + peripheral softness — still almost deniable.
Strong: visible breathing at the frame edges only, persistent motion lag.
Heavy: edible-tier — real breathing, halo bloom, constant lag.
